top_module.name: active_aero_supervisor
top_module.description: Top-level control, validation, safety, request/response, telemetry, clamp, and fallback integration block for active aerodynamics. This module exposes the external request and response transaction ports, qualifies request launches, stores outstanding transaction state, accepts only matching and fresh responses, generates deterministic actuator commands from accepted model outputs, saturates outputs to programmed bounds, and prioritizes safe fallback on any fault or invalid condition.
top_module.functionality: Implements the complete digital control contract for active-aerodynamics supervision. The module accepts qualified control inputs and external model responses, packages request metadata including geometry reference and flow conditions, launches a request only when the stream velocity lies inside the configured operating envelope unless fallback routing is explicitly enabled, tracks outstanding request ID/sequence/timestamp, validates response request ID/sequence/age/format, synthesizes a deterministic actuator command from accepted model outputs, saturates the command to programmable min/max, and outputs safe fallback command data when needed. The module is synthesizable and deterministic, contains no model inference, and ensures actuator outputs are only driven from registered/supervised data.
responsibilities: Qualify outbound model requests using input-validity, envelope, and fallback-routing rules.
Generate and retain request ID, sequence, and timestamp for each outstanding transaction.
Accept only matching, fresh, well-formed responses.
Reject stale, malformed, mismatched, or timed-out responses without influencing actuator output.
Map accepted model outputs to a bounded actuator command word using local hardware logic.
Prioritize fallback command over model-derived command whenever fallback_active is asserted.
Expose safety status bits and sticky telemetry counters.
Guarantee registered actuator command output with no combinational path from response inputs to actuator outputs.
top_module.reset_behavior: On rst_n deassertion, all outstanding request state, response qualification state, sticky status bits, counters, and command outputs shall return to a safe known state. The registered actuator_cmd shall default to the safe fallback command parameter value, actuator_cmd_valid shall deassert, model_request_valid shall deassert, safety_status shall indicate safe fallback/default conditions as implemented, and no outstanding transaction shall remain pending.
behavior_rules: Request launch occurs only when control_valid, vehicle_geometry_valid, and flow_conditions_valid are asserted together and the stream velocity is inside the configured operating envelope unless host_fallback_route_en is asserted.
The operating envelope defaults to inclusive 20 to 55 m/s behavior when host override inputs are not used; host_operating_en_min_mps and host_operating_en_max_mps may refine the envelope if provided.
Each launched request captures a new request ID, sequence number, and timestamp in registers until response acceptance or timeout.

Request and response channels shall be treated as valid/ready-equivalent transaction channels internally, but no combinational dependency from model_response inputs to actuator_cmd outputs is permitted.
A response is accepted only if request ID, sequence, freshness age, and format checks all pass.
A rejected response shall assert stale_reject and/or invalid_response as appropriate, increment the corresponding telemetry counter, and shall not update actuator command synthesis inputs.
Command synthesis shall be deterministic and parameterizable for active-aerodynamics actuator domain scaling, but shall not perform physics inference.
All model-derived commands shall be clamped to COMMAND_MIN/COMMAND_MAX before output and clamp_active shall assert for at least one cycle when saturation occurs.
Fallback command selection has priority over all model-derived commands whenever fallback_active is asserted or a safety fault requires fallback.
Telemetry counters and sticky status bits shall be clocked by clk and only clear on host_clear_sticky or reset as applicable.

modules.name: request_manager
modules.description: Handles request qualification, transaction ID/sequence generation, request payload formatting, and outstanding transaction tracking for the external DoMINO service.
modules.functionality: Generates a new transaction context for each qualified control cycle, formats a transaction payload containing geometry reference and flow conditions, and retains request metadata until completion or timeout. Enforces the operating envelope rules and supports host-directed fallback routing.
responsibilities: Capture and increment request ID and sequence number only on qualified and granted launches.
Package geometry reference and stream velocity into the outbound request payload.
Assert request_valid_out only when a request is launched to the external service.
Hold outstanding request metadata until cleared by response acceptance or timeout.
Report envelope violations for safety supervision.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset clears outstanding transaction state, request counter outputs, pending flags, and payload validity to safe defaults.
behavior_rules: A request shall only be launched when all input-validity conditions are true and the velocity lies within the configured envelope unless fallback routing is enabled.
The request payload shall include transaction identifiers, geometry reference, and flow/velocity context in a deterministic encoded format.
request_pending_out shall remain asserted while a request is outstanding.
No new request shall be issued while a prior request remains pending unless the prior transaction has cleared or timed out.
request_id_out and request_seq_out shall only update on a granted launch event.

modules.name: response_validator
modules.description: Accepts asynchronous model response transactions, validates request ID, sequence, freshness age, and payload format, and converts accepted data into normalized model output words for downstream command synthesis.
modules.functionality: Parses the external response payload and qualifies it against the outstanding request context. The validator emits accepted model output words only when the request ID and sequence match and the response age is within the programmed freshness window. Mismatch, malformed format, stale age, or timeout conditions are separated into explicit status outputs.
responsibilities: Check response request ID against the outstanding request ID.
Check response sequence against the outstanding sequence.
Check response age against the freshness window and timeout policy.
Parse drag_force, lift_force, surface_pressure, and flow_field metadata fields from the payload.
Assert explicit stale, invalid, and timeout indicators for supervisory consumption.
Provide normalized model-output words only on accepted responses.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset clears all acceptance, stale, invalid, timeout, and parsed-output state to safe defaults.
behavior_rules: A response shall be accepted only when request ID and sequence both match the outstanding transaction and the response age is within the freshness window.
Any failure of ID, sequence, format, or age checks shall be flagged as stale or invalid and shall not update accepted model output data.
Timeout detection shall assert when the outstanding transaction exceeds the programmable timeout window.
No output word derived from a rejected response may be used by command synthesis.

modules.name: command_synthesizer
modules.description: Deterministic local hardware mapping from accepted model output words to a bounded actuator command word. Implements domain-specific table/logic behavior without surrogate inference.
modules.functionality: Implements a fixed, synthesizable command-generation function that converts validated model outputs into a deterministic actuator command word. The implementation may use arithmetic, comparisons, lookup tables, and hardwired scaling, but it shall not contain the physics or surrogate model itself.
responsibilities: Generate a deterministic actuator command from accepted drag/lift/pressure/metadata inputs.
Select safe fallback command when fallback is active, with priority over model-derived commands.
Provide a raw command word for downstream clamping.
Indicate whether the current command source is fallback or model-derived.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset forces command output invalid and returns internal state to a safe deterministic baseline.
behavior_rules: Command synthesis shall be purely local hardware logic with no neural-network, GPU, or floating-point surrogate inference dependencies.
Fallback command selection shall have priority over all model-derived outputs whenever fallback_active_in is asserted.
The raw output command shall remain deterministic for a given accepted input tuple.
command_valid_out shall only assert when the upstream response has been accepted or fallback is selected as a valid safe output source.

modules.name: clamp_unit
modules.description: Applies programmable minimum and maximum command saturation to the synthesized actuator command word and produces a clamp-active indication.
modules.functionality: Saturates incoming command values to the programmable output bounds. When saturation occurs, the output is pinned to the nearest bound and clamp_active_out asserts for at least one clock cycle.
responsibilities: Clamp command to the configured minimum and maximum bounds.
Assert clamp_active_out when saturation occurs.
Pass through valid commands unchanged when within bounds.
Provide a registered bounded command suitable for actuator driver logic.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset clears clamp state and drives a safe bounded default command with validity deasserted.
behavior_rules: If command_in exceeds the maximum bound, command_out shall saturate to the maximum bound.
If command_in is below the minimum bound, command_out shall saturate to the minimum bound.
clamp_active_out shall remain asserted for at least one cycle on any saturation event.
No combinational path from external response inputs shall bypass the registered clamp stage to actuator outputs.

modules.name: safety_supervisor
modules.description: Monitors request timeouts, response validity, envelope compliance, command bounds, and internal fault conditions. It generates safety status bits, fallback enable, and sticky telemetry semantics.
modules.functionality: Aggregates supervisory fault inputs into safety status bits and fallback selection. It asserts fallback when timeout, stale response, malformed response, envelope violation, out-of-bounds command, or internal fault conditions are detected. Sticky status bits remain asserted until cleared by host register write or reset.
responsibilities: Monitor all safety-relevant conditions each cycle.
Assert stale_reject, timeout_fault, invalid_response, clamp_active, and fallback_active semantics.
Aggregate safety status bits into a compact output vector.
Hold sticky fault/status bits until cleared by host_clear_sticky or reset.
Inhibit model-derived actuation whenever fallback is required.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset clears all fault indicators, fallback selection, and sticky state to safe known values.
behavior_rules: On timeout, stale response, malformed payload, out-of-envelope velocity, command bound violation, or internal fault, fallback_active_out shall assert.
stale_reject_out shall assert when a response is rejected for age or transaction mismatch.
invalid_response_out shall assert for malformed payload or format failures.
timeout_fault_out shall assert for request timeout.
clamp_active_out shall mirror clamp events for safety reporting.
Sticky bits shall remain asserted until cleared by host_clear_sticky or reset.

modules.name: telemetry_monitor
modules.description: Synthesizable counters and sticky status visibility for accepted responses, rejected stale responses, clamp events, timeout events, and fallback activations.
modules.functionality: Counts relevant events and exposes sticky status bits for host observability. The counters and sticky bits are synthesizable, clocked by clk, and clear on reset or host-controlled sticky clear when applicable.
responsibilities: Increment accepted response counter on valid accepted-response pulses.
Increment rejected stale counter on stale rejection pulses.
Increment clamp event counter on clamp saturation pulses.
Increment timeout counter on timeout pulses.
Increment fallback activation counter on fallback selection pulses.
Expose sticky status for host debug and software monitoring.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset clears all counters and sticky bits to zero.
behavior_rules: Telemetry counters shall be monotonic until reset; host sticky clear affects sticky bits only, not counters, unless otherwise implemented as secure programming policy.
All telemetry logic shall be clocked by clk.
Telemetry shall not affect actuator output timing or create a combinational path to actuator_cmd.

top_level_connections.description: Top-level clock fans out to all synchronous submodules.
Top-level active-low reset fans out to all submodules.
Host control qualification input into request manager.
Geometry validity qualification input into request manager.
Flow-condition validity qualification input into request manager.
Stream velocity input into request manager for envelope qualification.
Geometry reference input into request manager request packaging.
Host routing override into request manager.
Host-programmable minimum envelope into request manager.
Host-programmable maximum envelope into request manager.
Host-programmable freshness window into response validator.

Top-level host timeout configuration is reflected in supervisory grant/hold policy as implemented by the contract; the request manager consumes the launch-grant control path. The exact timeout threshold is used internally by safety logic and response validation timing state.
Host clear input for sticky safety and telemetry state.
Asynchronous external model response valid qualifier into response validator.
External model response payload into response validator.
Outbound request payload driven by request manager.
Registered bounded actuator command valid output driven by clamp unit.
Registered bounded actuator command output driven by clamp unit.
Safety status output driven by safety supervisor.
Telemetry accepted-response counter output.
Telemetry stale-reject counter output.
Telemetry clamp-event counter output.
Telemetry timeout-event counter output.
Telemetry fallback-activation counter output.
